lastCompletedStory.title: Add warn-level runtime guard for handoff.officialDocsValidated

nextStoryContext: US-002 added a targeted, hand-rolled warn-level guard (validateOfficialDocsValidated in src/supervisor/events.ts) over handoff.officialDocsValidated: checks each entry's status against the handoff.schema.json enum (aligned/corrected/no_external_lib_touched/fetch_failed) and flags any object key outside {lib, status, url, fetchedAt, summary}. Violations emit a new non-fatal 'handoff-schema-warning' WorkerEventKind (HandoffSchemaWarningEventDetail: field/index/issues), never a throw or hard-failure -- one offending entry collapses all its issues into exactly one warning event, matching the AC wording. Wired at the existing result-event site in loop.ts (reuses the same _readHandoff() read already made for buildResultDetail, no extra fs hit). No new dependency added. Unit tests cover the pure validator (conformant/invalid/multi-entry/absent/non-array) plus a full runSupervisor lifecycle test asserting exactly one 'handoff-schema-warning' event and result.status still 'complete'. Raised 3 file-size-budget ceilings (events.ts 577->662, loop.ts 2033->2040, events.test.ts 412->510) with a CAM-229 tracker ref in the same staged diff. All PRD stories now pass (prd.json fully flipped) -- the next agent should check prd.json for whether the PRD is PRD_COMPLETE or a new story was added.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal supervisor-observability guard; no external library surface touched.
